title.narrative: IDENTIFICATION OF PRIORITY URBAN DEVELOPMENT INTERVENTIONS TO PROMOTE INVESTMENTS, SMART APPLICATIONS AND LIVEABLE DAHAB CITY

description.narrative:
As the world tries to recover from the severe socio-economic impacts of COVID-19, it is vital to capitalize on opportunities that cities have that enable them to manage this crisis and emerge as hubs of innovation leading sustainable response and recovery. This project emerges from the recommendations to take conscious policy choices, particularly with respect to inequalities, local capacities, and a green, inclusive recovery further into implementation.
This project emerges as the second phase of a regional programme that supported participatory city-wide development with a focus on social, economic, and environmental aspects. The first phase of the project selected 12 Arab cities to participate in an intense knowledge exchange and capacity building workshops to implement the integrated city-wide approach and coming up with priority intervention areas and projects.
In the current phase of the programme three of the highest-scoring cities were selected for developing preliminary feasibility studies for identified priority projects resulting from phase one. In Egypt, Dahab was recommended by the government due to its strategic role to complement the strategic planning efforts taking place in the region. Moreover, the city and governorate leaders have shown outstanding political will and readiness to support the implementation of city development plans which would support strongly this project. Dahab will act as the leading example for application, while other cities are planned to follow in later stages.
The project takes place in Dahab City, a city in southern Sinai Government Egypt with 21,000 Inhabitat that has shown high potentials for economic growth and in playing a vital regional role. This project aims to support Dahab in improving its urban environment and strengthening its economic supporting activities along with a diversification of its economic base, while preserving and strengthening its heritage and cultural identity.
This critical phase of cooperation will enable a national and local framework to help establish an impact investment platform and build the capacities and share knowledge towards this anticipated objective. The selected projects will represent pilot cases not only to directly support Dahab city, but also to build national and local capacity for replication. In this sense, various types of soft and hard projects will be selected to ensure the feasibility formulation process and related technical support is broad and replicable. The project approach focuses on bridging the city investment gap by enabling the needed tools and studies for matching and cross finance, blending financial resources, and supporting impact investment at the city level. The inclusion of various levels and types of stakeholders will support future knowledge sharing and replication. The project will also look at how Islamic finance resource mobilization and distribution models can be embedded as part of the overall project to fund the sustainable development and equitable distribution of income within the city and surrounding region.
Main expected Accomplishments • Enable the implementation of the inclusive sustainable development priorities in line with the Strategic Urban Plan of Dahab through developing feasibility studies • Support mobilizing and blending shariah compliant impact investments in Dahab district through setting up and capacitating investment platform at South Sinai Governate • Enhance local capacities and knowledge sharing by developing scale-up strategy
